column1: # Ceilings for scripts/ci/check_hello_size.sh (NU-106, A12 N1). linux/amd64,
# CGO off, -trimpath, the Go version of go.mod. Measured 2026-10-06 when the
# CLI and the test-only dependencies left the framework's module:
#   program        modules  linked  packages  stripped bytes
# modules, linked and packages are those figures exactly: one more is a
# dependency or a package that arrived, which is a decision to make in the
# pull request that brings it. stripped bytes carries 2% of headroom, because
# the binary grows with every line of code in a linked package and the other
# three do not. Raise a ceiling in the pull request that needs it and say why
# in its description.
# 2026-10-12, rebased on main with Go 1.26.9: packages 373 -> 374 and
# 384 -> 385. pkg/db now imports internal/knownproviders, so the startup
# warning for an engine with no unique-violation classifier can name the
# module that fixes it (NU-118, nucleus#612). Measured on the CI runner:
# program
hello
hello+sqlite
